select r.rqst_no, r.rqst_login_id, r.rqst_mngr_nm, r.rqst_duty_cd, r.rqst_dt, r.aprv_dt, r.rqst_stts_cd, r.aprv_id, r.rjct_rsn_cn, r.rmrk_cn, r.user_no, r.apt_cmplex_no, a.apt_cmplex_nm, case r.rqst_duty_cd when 'HEAD' then '관리소장' when 'ACNT' then '회계' when 'ADM' then '행정' when 'FAC' then '시설' else r.rqst_duty_cd end as duty_nm, case r.rqst_stts_cd when 'wait' then '승인대기' when 'ok' then '승인완료' when 'reject' then '반려' else r.rqst_stts_cd end as stts_nm from mngr_rqst r left join apt_complex a on r.apt_cmplex_no = a.apt_cmplex_no
and ( lower(r.rqst_mngr_nm) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(r.rqst_login_id) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(a.apt_cmplex_nm) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' )
and r.rqst_stts_cd = #{status}
and ( r.rqst_duty_cd = #{role} or case r.rqst_duty_cd when 'HEAD' then '관리소장' when 'ACNT' then '회계' when 'ADM' then '행정' when 'FAC' then '시설' else r.rqst_duty_cd end = #{role} )
order by r.rqst_dt desc, r.rqst_no desc

select r.rqst_no, r.rqst_login_id, r.rqst_mngr_nm, r.rqst_duty_cd, r.rqst_dt, r.aprv_dt, r.rqst_stts_cd, r.aprv_id, r.rjct_rsn_cn, r.rmrk_cn, r.user_no, r.apt_cmplex_no, a.apt_cmplex_nm, case r.rqst_duty_cd when 'HEAD' then '관리소장' when 'ACNT' then '회계' when 'ADM' then '행정' when 'FAC' then '시설' else r.rqst_duty_cd end as duty_nm from mngr_rqst r left join apt_complex a on r.apt_cmplex_no = a.apt_cmplex_no where r.rqst_no = #{rqstNo}

select m.user_no, m.user_id, m.user_nm, m.user_telno, m.user_eml, m.user_yn, m.reg_dt, m.mdfcn_dt, g.mgmt_ofc_no, g.mngr_duty_cd, o.apt_cmplex_no, a.apt_cmplex_nm, case g.mngr_duty_cd when 'HEAD' then '관리소장' when 'ACNT' then '회계' when 'ADM' then '행정' when 'FAC' then '시설' else g.mngr_duty_cd end as duty_nm, to_char(nvl(m.mdfcn_dt, m.reg_dt), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_login_dt, to_char(nvl(m.mdfcn_dt, m.reg_dt), 'HH24:MI') as last_login_tm from member m join manager g on m.user_no = g.user_no left join mgmt_office o on g.mgmt_ofc_no = o.mgmt_ofc_no left join apt_complex a on o.apt_cmplex_no = a.apt_cmplex_no
and ( lower(m.user_nm) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(m.user_id) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' or lower(a.apt_cmplex_nm) like '%' || lower(#{keyword}) || '%' )
and m.user_yn = 'Y' and m.user_yn = 'N'
and ( g.mngr_duty_cd = #{role} or case g.mngr_duty_cd when 'HEAD' then '관리소장' when 'ACNT' then '회계' when 'ADM' then '행정' when 'FAC' then '시설' else g.mngr_duty_cd end = #{role} )
order by m.reg_dt desc, m.user_no desc

select m.user_no, m.user_id, m.user_nm, m.user_telno, m.user_eml, m.user_yn, m.reg_dt, m.mdfcn_dt, g.mgmt_ofc_no, g.mngr_duty_cd, o.apt_cmplex_no, a.apt_cmplex_nm, case g.mngr_duty_cd when 'HEAD' then '관리소장' when 'ACNT' then '회계' when 'ADM' then '행정' when 'FAC' then '시설' else g.mngr_duty_cd end as duty_nm, to_char(nvl(m.mdfcn_dt, m.reg_dt), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as last_login_dt, to_char(nvl(m.mdfcn_dt, m.reg_dt), 'HH24:MI') as last_login_tm from member m join manager g on m.user_no = g.user_no left join mgmt_office o on g.mgmt_ofc_no = o.mgmt_ofc_no left join apt_complex a on o.apt_cmplex_no = a.apt_cmplex_no where m.user_no = #{userNo}
select count(*) from member where user_id = #{userId}
